title: inputData
description: A heatmap chart widget for visualizing data intensity across two categorical or ordinal dimensions. Use this widget to display patterns in data such as activity over time, correlation matrices, geographic data density, or any metric that varies across two axes. Colors represent value intensity from minimum to maximum, with optional continuous gradient or discrete block rendering. Ideal for identifying patterns, anomalies, and trends in multi-dimensional data.

title.title: Title
title.description: The main heading displayed above the heatmap. Use to describe what data relationship is being visualized.

subTitle.title: Subtitle
subTitle.description: Secondary text displayed below the title. Use for additional context like data source, time period, or measurement units.

axis.title: Axis Settings
axis.description: Configuration for the chart axes and legend display.

xAxisLabel.title: X-Axis Label
xAxisLabel.description: Label text displayed below the horizontal axis. Describes what the x-dimension represents (e.g., 'Hour of Day', 'Category').

yAxisLabel.title: Y-Axis Label
yAxisLabel.description: Label text displayed beside the vertical axis. Describes what the y-dimension represents (e.g., 'Day of Week', 'Sensor ID').

showLegend.title: Show Legend
showLegend.description: When enabled, displays a color scale legend showing the mapping between colors and heat values.

heatMap.title: Heat Settings
heatMap.description: Configuration for the heatmap color mapping and value display.

min.title: Min Value
min.description: The lower bound of the heat scale. Values at or below this will be colored with the first color in the heat colors array. Set based on your data's expected minimum.

max.title: Max Value
max.description: The upper bound of the heat scale. Values at or above this will be colored with the last color in the heat colors array. Set based on your data's expected maximum.

continuous.title: Continuous
continuous.description: When enabled, colors blend smoothly as a continuous gradient between defined colors. When disabled, colors appear as discrete blocks with sharp boundaries.

showValues.title: Show Values
showValues.description: When enabled, displays the numeric heat value inside each cell. Useful for precise reading but may clutter dense heatmaps.

colors.title: Heat Colors
colors.description: Array of colors defining the heat scale gradient, from lowest to highest values. Common patterns: blue-to-red for temperature, white-to-dark for intensity, green-yellow-red for status.

items.title: Color
items.description: A color in the gradient scale. Add multiple colors for richer gradients (e.g., blue → yellow → red).

dataseries.title: Dataseries
dataseries.description: Array of data series configurations. Each series provides the data points for the heatmap grid.

label.title: Label
label.description: The name identifier for this data series. Used in tooltips and legends.

data.title: Data
data.description: Array of data points. Each point specifies its x position, y position, and heat value.

x.title: x Value
x.description: The horizontal axis category or value for this data point (e.g., hour number, category name).

y.title: y Value
y.description: The vertical axis category or value for this data point (e.g., day name, sensor ID).

heat.title: Heat Value
heat.description: The numeric intensity value that determines the cell color based on the heat color scale.

pivot.title: Split Data by
pivot.description: Column value used to split data into multiple heatmaps. Each unique value creates a separate chart (e.g., split by region to show one heatmap per region).
